meta.name: security-research
meta.description: Team Mode security research skill. Orchestrates 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit a codebase in parallel, prove exploitability, classify root causes, and calibrate severity by actual exploitability. Use for security review, vulnerability research, exploitability audit, pre-release security check, threat model validation, and `/security-research`. Triggers: 'security-research', 'security research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', 'exploitability audit', '보안 리뷰', '취약점 감사'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行审计代码库，发现漏洞并验证可利用性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要对代码库进行深度安全审查并验证漏洞可利用性
copy.tagline_en: Audit codebases in parallel, find vulnerabilities and verify exploitability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need deep security review of codebases with exploitability validation

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会组建一个 5 人团队(3 名漏洞猎人、2 名 PoC 工程师),并行审计代码库,验证漏洞是否可被利用,按 CWE 分类根因,并根据实际可利用性评估严重性,最后输出带结论的安全审计报告。
howto.when: 当用户要求进行安全审查、漏洞研究、可利用性审计、发布前安全检查、威胁模型验证,或说出 “security-research”、“security review”、“보안 리뷰” 等触发词时启动。

say.text: 对这个仓库做一次安全审计,跑一遍 security-research。
审计当前分支相对主分支的改动,找出可被利用的漏洞。
用 security-research 检查这个 PR 的威胁模型并给出结论。

howto.what_en: Claude creates a 5-member team (3 vulnerability hunters, 2 PoC engineers) to audit the codebase in parallel, verify exploitability, classify root causes by CWE, score severity by actual exploitability, and produce a security report with a verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a security review, vulnerability research, exploitability audit, pre-release security check, or threat model validation, or says keywords such as “security-research”, “security review”, “보안 리뷰”.

say_en.text: Run a security audit on this repository with security-research.
Audit the current branch diff against the main branch for exploitable vulnerabilities.
Use security-research to review the threat model of this PR and give a verdict.
say_en.note: The output ends with PASS, PASS WITH FINDINGS, or BLOCK.
